QuestInfo.0: You noticed Ethan standing around with his face all red. You couldn't tell if he was angry or queasy. Ask him what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: It's hard to tell whether you should take Ethan's claims at face value. Maybe you should see what Jenny has to say.
